cards.english_title: SpaceX Catches Starship After Its Fiery Return
cards.korean_desc: 이 기술은 우주 발사를 싸고 자주 만들 수 있다 스타십은 지구를 14번 돌고 스타링크 위성 26개를 배치했다 슈퍼헤비 부스터는 포획에 실패해 멕시코만에 떨어졌다 분석가들은 중요한 임무 전 반복 성공이 필요하다고 말한다
cards.english_desc: The feat could make space launches cheaper and more frequent. Starship survived reentry, orbited Earth 14 times, and deployed 26 Starlink satellites. The Super Heavy booster failed its catch attempt and splashed down in the Gulf of Mexico. Analysts say SpaceX needs repeated successes before sensitive missions.
cards.takeaway_english: The next test is whether SpaceX can repeat the catch safely.

why_it_matters.english: Starship may carry satellites, people, and equipment to the Moon or Mars.
why_it_matters.korean: 스타십은 위성과 사람을 달과 화성으로 보낼 수 있다

parties.label: SpaceX
parties.english: The company demonstrated a possible path to fully reusable spaceships.

parties.label: NASA
parties.english: NASA expects Starship to serve as a lunar lander for Artemis.

parties.label: SpaceX critics
parties.english: They say repeated successful catches are still needed for important missions.
parties.korean: 중요 임무에는 반복 성공이 필요하다고 말한다

views.label: SpaceX and supporters
views.english: The catch shows that fully reusable spaceflight can work and may lower launch costs.

views.label: Analysts
views.english: One success is important, but repeated catches must prove the system is ready.
views.korean: 한 번의 성공만으로는 아직 부족하다고 본다

disagree.english: Supporters see a breakthrough, while analysts warn that reliability matters more than one dramatic test.
disagree.korean: 지지자들은 돌파구로 보지만 분석가들은 신뢰성이 더 중요하다고 말한다

cards.english_title: NATO Drops Albania Summit as Meetings Shrink
cards.korean_desc: 에디 라마 총리는 아직 공통 날짜가 없다고 말했다 국방장관들도 10월 회의를 놓쳤고 2027년 회의도 없다 나토는 필요할 때 만나며 다음 날짜는 정하지 않았다
cards.english_desc: Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama said there is no common date yet. Defense ministers also missed their October meeting, with none planned for October 2027. NATO says it will meet when a necessity exists, without setting the next summit date.
cards.hook: NATO will not hold Albania’s summit in 2027.
cards.takeaway_english: The change saves preparation costs but leaves questions about alliance unity.
cards.takeaway_korean: 변화는 비용을 줄이지만 동맹 단결에는 의문을 남긴다

why_it_matters.english: Summits signal unity to countries watching NATO’s security commitments.
Large meetings require major security and public spending.

parties.english: The alliance is reducing some high-level meetings.

parties.label: Albania

views.korean: 필요할 때 정상회의를 열면 된다고 본다

views.label: Critics

views.korean: 회의 감소는 동맹 갈등을 보여준다고 본다

cards.english_title: Congo’s Ebola Outbreak Still Spreads After Six Months
cards.korean_desc: 환자는 1만 1천 명 이상이고 거의 절반이 사망했다 새 환자 80퍼센트는 감시 밖에서 발견된다 11월 12일 콩고는 확진 1만 1197명과 사망 5471명이었다
cards.english_desc: More than 11,000 cases are recorded, and nearly half have died. Most new cases are found outside surveillance, making contact tracing difficult. As of November 12, Congo had 11,197 confirmed cases and 5,471 deaths.
cards.hook: Congo’s Ebola outbreak remains out of control.
cards.takeaway_english: The outbreak needs stronger care, tracking, and community protection.
cards.takeaway_korean: 이 유행에는 더 강한 치료와 추적이 필요하다

why_it_matters.english: Children face especially high death rates from the disease.
why_it_matters.korean: 어린이들은 특히 높은 사망률에 놓여 있다

why_it_matters.english: Cases have spread beyond Congo into several African countries.
why_it_matters.korean: 환자는 콩고 밖 여러 아프리카 국가로 퍼졌다

parties.label: Congo
parties.english: The country has recorded more than 11,000 cases.

parties.label: Health workers
parties.english: Workers face attacks, unpaid wages, and difficult treatment conditions.
parties.korean: 보건 노동자들은 공격과 임금 체불을 겪는다

parties.label: Aid groups
parties.english: Aid groups question how more than $700 million was managed.

views.label: Health experts
views.english: Weak tracing, isolation, and community surveillance are allowing transmission to continue.
views.korean: 추적과 격리가 약해 전파가 계속된다고 본다

views.label: MSF
views.english: Resources raised for the response are not reaching patients and frontline workers sufficiently.
views.korean: 지원금이 환자와 현장 노동자에게 충분히 닿지 않는다고 본다

disagree.english: Officials may point to the scale of the outbreak and conflict, while aid groups stress management failures.
disagree.korean: 당국은 규모와 분쟁을 말하지만 구호단체는 운영 실패를 강조한다

cards.reader_question_korean: 추적, 치료, 안전한 장례 중 무엇이 먼저일까요?

cards.english_title: Cape Verde May Elect Its First Woman President
cards.korean_desc: 카보베르데는 11월 15일 조아나 로사가 네베스에 도전한다 로사는 1975년 독립 후 첫 여성 대통령이 될 수 있다 후보 6명이 경쟁하고 과반이 없으면 11월 29일 결선이다 네베스의 당이 정부를 장악해 로사 승리는 정치 대립을 만든다 과반 후보가 없으면 유권자는 11월 29일 다시 투표한다
cards.english_desc: Cape Verde votes on November 15, 2026, with Joana Rosa challenging José Maria Neves. Rosa could become the country’s first woman president since independence in 1975. Six candidates are competing, and a runoff comes November 29 if nobody wins half the votes. Neves’s party controls government, so Rosa’s victory would create rival political camps. If no candidate wins outright, voters return for the scheduled runoff on November 29.
cards.hook: Cape Verde could elect its first woman president.
cards.takeaway_english: The election tests both gender expectations and the country’s political balance.
cards.takeaway_korean: 이번 선거는 성 역할과 정치 균형을 시험한다

why_it_matters.english: Women carry much household financial responsibility, but policies have not addressed that burden.
why_it_matters.korean: 여성들이 가계 부담을 지지만 정책은 이를 해결하지 못했다

parties.label: Joana Rosa
parties.english: The former justice minister is the first woman to run for president since independence.
parties.korean: 전 법무장관으로 독립 후 첫 여성 후보다

parties.label: José Maria Neves
parties.english: The incumbent president is seeking a second term.
parties.korean: 현 대통령으로 두 번째 임기를 노린다

parties.label: PAICV
parties.english: The governing party backs Neves and controls parliament and most municipalities.

views.label: Roselma Evora
views.english: Voters want leaders who understand daily problems and better economic prospects.
views.korean: 유권자들은 생활 문제를 아는 지도자를 원한다

views.label: Rosário Luz
views.english: Party loyalty may matter more than Rosa’s gender, while women’s policies remain weak.
views.korean: 당 충성도가 성별보다 중요할 수 있다고 본다

disagree.english: Some see a historic gender breakthrough, while others say party politics and policy matter more.
disagree.korean: 누군가는 역사적 변화로 보지만 다른 사람들은 정당과 정책이 더 중요하다고 본다

cards.english_title: India Rejects UN Call for a Death Penalty Moratorium
cards.korean_desc: 193개국 총회는 찬성 133표 반대 33표 기권 16표로 채택했다 결의안은 국가들에 사형을 멈추고 폐지하라고 촉구했다 인도는 주권국가가 법과 형벌을 정해야 한다고 말했다
cards.english_desc: The 193-member assembly adopted it with 133 votes for, 33 against, and 16 abstentions. The resolution urged countries to pause executions and work toward abolition. India said sovereign states should decide their legal systems and penalties.
cards.hook: India voted against a global death penalty moratorium.
cards.takeaway_english: The vote passed globally, but countries remain divided over executions.
cards.takeaway_korean: 결의안은 통과됐지만 국가들은 사형 문제로 갈라져 있다

why_it_matters.english: The vote shows continuing disagreement over national law and human rights.
why_it_matters.korean: 이번 표결은 국내법과 인권의 계속되는 충돌을 보여준다

why_it_matters.english: The resolution also sought limits for minors, pregnant women, and disabled people.
why_it_matters.korean: 결의안은 미성년자와 임산부 등의 사형 제한도 요구했다

parties.label: India
parties.english: India voted against the resolution and defended each country’s legal authority.
parties.korean: 인도는 결의안에 반대하고 각국의 법 권한을 옹호했다

parties.label: United Nations
parties.english: The General Assembly adopted the resolution by 133 votes to 33.

parties.label: Mexico
parties.english: Mexico introduced the call for a moratorium on executions.

views.label: India
views.english: There is no international consensus against capital punishment, and sovereign states should choose penalties.
views.korean: 국제 합의가 없으므로 각국이 형벌을 정해야 한다고 본다

views.label: Resolution supporters
views.english: Countries should pause executions and move toward abolishing the death penalty.
views.korean: 국가들은 사형을 멈추고 폐지로 나아가야 한다고 본다

disagree.english: Opponents emphasize national sovereignty, while supporters emphasize human rights and limits on state power.
disagree.korean: 반대자들은 주권을 강조하고 지지자들은 인권과 국가 권력의 제한을 강조한다

cards.reader_question_korean: 국제 규칙이 사형 폐지를 이끌어야 할까요?

cards.english_title: U.S. Loses Measles-Free Status After Years of Spread
cards.korean_desc: 결정은 1년 넘게 이어진 지속 전파 뒤에 나왔다 2026년 11월 12일 질병통제예방센터는 45개 주에서 5182건을 확인했다 질병통제예방센터는 결정 뒤 대응을 크게 바꾸지 않는다고 말했다
cards.english_desc: The decision followed continuous transmission for more than one year. By November 12, 2026, the CDC had recorded 5,182 confirmed cases across 45 states. The CDC says its measles response will not fundamentally change after the decision.
cards.hook: The U.S. lost measles-elimination status after 26 years.
cards.takeaway_english: The status changed, but restoring high vaccination coverage remains the central task.
cards.takeaway_korean: 지위는 바뀌었지만 높은 접종률 회복이 핵심이다

why_it_matters.english: Measles can cause blindness, deafness, brain damage, or death.
why_it_matters.korean: 홍역은 실명과 난청과 뇌 손상과 사망을 일으킬 수 있다

why_it_matters.english: Lower community immunity puts people unable to receive vaccines at greater risk.
why_it_matters.korean: 지역 면역 저하는 백신을 못 맞는 사람을 더 위험하게 한다

parties.label: United States
parties.english: The country has recorded 5,182 confirmed cases in 2026 as of November 12.

parties.label: PAHO
parties.english: The regional health body revoked the United States’ elimination status.
parties.korean: 지역 보건기구는 미국의 퇴치 지위를 취소했다

parties.label: CDC
parties.english: The agency says its outbreak response will not fundamentally change.

views.label: Public health experts
views.english: Falling vaccination rates and continuous transmission caused the reversal.
views.korean: 접종률 하락과 지속 전파가 원인이라고 본다

views.label: U.S. health officials
views.english: The response can continue even without the elimination designation.
views.korean: 퇴치 지위가 없어도 대응은 계속할 수 있다고 본다

disagree.english: Experts stress vaccination gaps, while officials emphasize that the designation itself does not change outbreak work.
disagree.korean: 전문가들은 접종 부족을 강조하고 당국은 대응이 바뀌지 않는다고 말한다
